From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: security intake — SIG vs custom questionnaire (next steps)

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can route the intake correctly to Security/Compliance: 

Call recap (short):
- You’re evaluating Redwood to power an internal medical notes summarization feature (HIPAA scope).
- Primary concerns: PHI handling, residency, audit logs, and vendor access controls.
- Your security team prefers standardized artifacts when possible to accelerate procurement.

Items we need to triage next (can you confirm answers inline?):
1) Preferred questionnaire format: SIG/CAIQ prefill or your custom vendor questionnaire? If SIG/CAIQ is acceptable we can prefill most responses and attach SOC 2 artifacts.
2) SOC 2 status: are you able to accept our SOC 2 Type II report snapshot? We have a current report and an encrypted binder we can share under NDA.
3) Data residency: will Medigroup require EU residency for any patient data, or is US-only for now? (Impacts hosting + encryption key locality).
4) HIPAA BA Agreement: do you need a BAA before technical review, or can we proceed with questionnaire first?
5) Evidence items: samples requested commonly — architecture diagram, encryption-at-rest/in-transit statements, IAM/SCIM controls, retention/erasure workflow, and incident response timelines. Any other must-haves?

Attachments: I’ve attached a prefill template we use for SIGs (Redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx) and a one-page SOC 2 snapshot (Redwood_SOC2-snapshot.pdf) for quick review.

Next actions we propose after you confirm 1–4:
- If SIG accepted: we prefill and return within 48 business hours, then schedule a 30-min evidence walk-through with your security reviewer.
- If custom required: please drop your questionnaire and target deadline, we’ll scope evidence and estimate turn-around.

Thanks — copying Karthik (security SME) and Marissa (account lead) so they’re looped for evidence/commitments.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline below.

1) Questionnaire format: We prefer SIG/CAIQ when the vendor can prefill accurately — speeds procurement. Please prefill and flag any items that need narrative/context.
2) SOC 2: We can accept a SOC 2 Type II snapshot under an NDA and will ask for the SOC auditor contact if anything looks unclear.
3) Data residency: For this initial pilot, US-only is acceptable. If we expand to our EU products we’ll revisit residency requirements.
4) BAA: Legal typically signs a BAA before production onboarding, but it’s OK to proceed with questionnaire prefill and evidence collection in parallel.
5) Evidence: add a short note on KV cache behavior and whether logs include any PHI in plaintext. Also include a sample of your retention policy language we can hand to Legal.

We’ll aim to review your prefill within 3 business days once received. For scheduling the evidence walk-through, please propose a few slots next week (TZ: PST).

Thanks —
Olivia Barnes
Head of IT Security, Medigroup
olivia.barnes@medigroup.com

2) Evidence pack: I’ll attach a one-page architecture callout (redwood_arch_callout.pdf) and a short retention policy stub for Legal to adapt (retention_policy_sample.txt). We can push those to the Drive link Naomi referenced.

4) Timeline: Naomi prepares the prefill Wed COB PST; security will turn around annotated prefill + evidence within 48 business hours; propose a 30-min evidence walk-through the week of Sep 7 (I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PST).
